text:
noah: hey everyone, I9m Noah — starting on platform today. two quick questions: 1) where9s the canonical list of service owners and escalation contacts? 2) who handles temporary access (VPN, badge) and urgent PagerDuty coverage while I9m waiting on onboarding?

people-ops: welcome Noah! the canonical list is the Service Owners page in Confluence (Team Directory -> Service Owners). I9ll add you to the page viewers. temporary access requests go to facilities@redwood.com and we coordinate VPN via security.

infra-bot: auto: service-owners-page: https://redwood.internal/confluence/service-owners. last-updated: 2026-02-15 by luis. contains owner, primary PD contact, and escalation path.

noah: thanks. I tried opening the Confluence link and got a permission denied page.

people-ops: sorry — I9ll send a Confluence invite now. also DM me your employee email so I can kick off the facilities/badge request.

sre-oncall: @noah for urgent coverage: page #eng-oncall with subject "coverage request - <service> - <short description>" and include a contact. if you don9t have PD access, someone will pick it up. if SRE doesn't ack in 10 min, escalate to the EM oncall listed in the owner map.

kate (eng-manager): adding that your manager (me) is the fallback if SRE/EM can't be reached and the incident is customer-impacting. page me directly after making the coverage request and I9ll coordinate.

ops-facilities: @noah we process temp badges same day in most buildings. email facilities@redwood.com with your name, employee id, and visit date. CC people-ops and include a photo for the badge.

noah: awesome, that helps. one more: who owns GPU reservations and hardware access for infra?

people-ops: GPU reservations are via eng-infra reservations page (link in the Confluence owner map). hardware keys/cards handled by security@redwood.com and facilities.

noah: perfect, thanks everyone! will follow up after I accept the Confluence invite. :thumbsup:
